items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was this still Phil [Ponse]? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, yes, for a while, Philip Ponse.

ctx.x: Uh, you mean the large group? Well, after we did those -- did our dates, and the people liked them, and they'd be -- they were buying them, then had some people to write in about dance dates, you know, if we would do some, you know. Some one nights here, and then, you know. So the managers, they set them up.
Well, yes, for a while, Philip Ponse. Later on he got very ill there, and he passed. Then went on to other agents.
